settings.title: Check your shipping email
settings.text: When your order ships, we email you a tracking number and a link to the carrier's tracking page.

settings.title: Open your order status page
settings.text: Your order confirmation email has a View your order button. It opens your order status page, which shows the latest progress and tracking details.

settings.title: Or sign in to your account
settings.text: If you checked out with an account, every order and its status is listed under your order history.

settings.title: Still can't find it?
settings.text: Send us your order number and the email you ordered with and we'll check on it for you.
Find your tracking details in a few clicks.
